title: Pose Keren Pakai Kipas
setting: Rooftop of a small city building at golden-hour sunset, warm orange sky, water tower and clotheslines in the background.
caption: Kerennya ternyata ada yang modalin 😭 #chibi

scenes.image_prompt: Raka stands heroically at the rooftop edge, low camera angle, his long red scarf flowing dramatically in strong wind, smug confident smile, sunset behind him.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow push-in. The red scarf and hair whip dramatically in the wind, Raka slowly lifts his sunglasses with one finger and smirks. Epic orchestral swell.
scenes.audio: wind gusts, epic orchestral music swell, no speech

scenes.image_prompt: Wide shot reveals the wind source: Gue crouches just off to the side holding a big desk fan connected to a long orange extension cable, looking bored and sweaty, while Raka still poses heroically.
scenes.motion_prompt: Camera quickly pans to reveal Gue holding the desk fan aimed at Raka. Gue yawns, then looks straight at the camera with a deadpan face.
scenes.audio: electric fan humming, record scratch at the start

scenes.image_prompt: Gue has unplugged the fan and walks away holding the plug; Raka's scarf hangs limp, his hair flat, sunglasses crooked, frozen in an awkward pose.
scenes.motion_prompt: The fan winds down, Raka's scarf falls limp and his spiky hair droops. Raka keeps the pose, eyes darting nervously. A single cricket chirps.
scenes.audio: fan powering down, single cricket chirp, awkward silence
